title: Selective non-enzymatic electrochemical detection of dopamine using nickel molybdate nano-dots anchored on CNT fiber microelectrodes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,36596-36606
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05187H, Paper

Hamza Arif, Arfaa Sajid, Abid Ali, Nimra Ahmed, Munawar Iqbal, Salih Akyürekli, Murat Kaleli, Norah Alwadai, Umer Shafique, Arif Nazir
NiMoO4 nano-dots anchored on CNTF microelectrodes for the selective, non-enzymatic electrochemical detection of dopamine, showing high sensitivity, low detection limit, and excellent selectivity against interfering biomolecules.
